# The metric nails of `//pub/std/fastener/nail/metric`

Every DIN 1151 size, in both head forms, with the head EN 10230-1 gives its
wire. Each part is `//pub/std/fastener/nail/metric:<form>/<d>x<l>`, in
millimetres. "Head from" says where the head diameter comes from. "Point" is
the `nail-point` interface the nail implements, which decides where it fits.
"8d / 6d" is the pointside penetration EN 1995-1-1 asks of it, smooth and
profiled. "Per kg" is the approximate count per kilogram of the maker the sizes
come from. Any other size is the `nail` part. See
[CLASSIFICATION.md](CLASSIFICATION.md) and [README_metric.md](README_metric.md).
